xcode_project_policy.description: Huxley global policy for Xcode project creation

policy.description: All Xcode projects MUST reference actual source files, never copy them. This ensures all editors (Xcode, Cursor, terminal, Claude Code) work on the same files.

deprecated_generators: any script that copies source files

required_behavior: Must use PBXFileReference with relative paths
Must NOT copy files to project directory
forbidden_behavior: Using absolute file paths in project references

documentation.rationale: Linking files instead of copying ensures that all development tools work on the same source files, preventing sync issues and maintaining a single source of truth.
